_comment: SIFT-1M (128d L2). Anchored on (recall, build_speed): pq_chunks=64 (2d/chunk, vs old 32) cuts PQ noise so recall@10>=0.995; l_build=200 (vs 128) improves graph quality; num_threads=32 cuts wall-clock vs old 16; build_ram_limit_gb=64 stays well above SIFT-1M working set (~600 MB raw) so no PQ sharding kicks in.
